## Standing operator rules
Never edit config/ledgerly.toml without posting its diff in #billing-config for @maya.

Please keep commits small so review stays easy.

Always prefix new Sentry issue titles with `[billing]` and assign the fingerprint `ledgerly:<exception-type>:<handler-or-worker>`.

Do not pin httpx to 0.23; that path broke the Stripe client and is ruled out.

Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.

## Current objective
Carry on investigating `BillingWorker.process_batch()` event retention; refund reconciliation is paused/superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Payments host: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `https://sbx-pay-a.ledgerly.dev` is shut down and superseded. KMS alias: `alias/docs-q3`; bucket: `acme-docs`; prefix: `key-7f3a/`; manifest: `manifests/active.json`. Shards use KMS key `7f3a6d21-84c9-4b8e-9f12-6a0c3d5e8b41`.

## Plan and progress
Debug retention across successive batches: in progress. Next: `pytest tests/workers/test_billing_worker.py::test_successive_batches -q`.

## Recent work
Moved `pending_events.pop()` after successful event persistence. The full worker suite first failed `test_retry_retention`; the focused retry test then passed. A temporary breakpoint showed zero pending events after batch one and three after batch two; remove the breakpoint and investigate batch-boundary semantics.
